sloka: अद्यैतच्चित्रकूटस्य काननं निशितै: शरै: ।भिन्दन् शत्रुशरीराणि करिष्ये शोणितोक्षितम् ॥ २.९६.२९॥
transliteration: adyaitaccitrakūṭasya kānanaṁ niśitai: śarai: ।bhindan śatruśarīrāṇi kariṣye śoṇitokṣitam ॥ 2.96.29॥

translations.english: Today I shall rend the bodies of enemies with my sharpened arrows and spatter the forest of Chitrakuta mountain with their blood.
